goal: Nest/stack the three identical bowls into one stack, then return the arm(s) to the start pose. Distractor objects are on the table.
success: bowl0, bowl1 and bowl2 each: local +z axis within 45 degrees (strictly less than) of world up (is_axis_up, axis [0,0,1], threshold 45 deg), i.e. no bowl is upside-down or tipped more than 45 deg.

The lowest bowl (the one with the smallest root z among bowl0/1/2, chosen at evaluation time) has its local +z axis within 7 degrees (strictly less) of world up, i.e. the bottom bowl sits (nearly) flat and upright.

is_stacked with label_list=[bowl0, bowl1, bowl2], in_order=False, xy_threshold=0.04 m, no z_threshold: root positions sorted by height; each vertically adjacent pair has horizontal (XY) root distance <= 0.04 m and root z gap >= 0.005 m (no upper limit). Any bowl may be bottom/middle/top.

all_robot_back_to_origin: every target arm's end-effector pose is within 0.15 m per axis (|dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m) and within 20 degrees (quaternion angular distance) of its start-of-episode pose (the arms must be returned to roughly their starting pose).
evaluation: Success conditions form ONE stage: after every action (once all simulation sub-steps of that action are done) the reward manager evaluates all conditions; the episode succeeds as soon as ALL hold simultaneously at the same moment (reward 1 -> episode ends with success). Conditions are not latched or ordered. Otherwise the episode ends as a failure after step_lim=800 actions (the check made after the last action still counts). No early-fail rule exists apart from the environment being flagged invalid (e.g. a required label missing / physics broken).
objects: bowl0, bowl1, bowl2: three bowls, all the SAME asset (select mode 'same' -> one randomly chosen model from category 'bowl', indices 11,12,13,14,15), 3 total, random positions on the table x in [-0.45,0.45], y in [-0.25,0.07] (Table-relative), upright, no random rotation

clutter: 20 distractor objects total (two clutter groups of 10, category_unique: one group in the front/back y bands y in [-0.5,-0.15] and [0.05,0.5] over x in [-0.6,0.6]; one group in the middle band y in [-0.15,0.05] with x in [-0.6,-0.1] or [0.1,0.6]), random yaw up to +-30 deg, margin 0.015 m; strip [-0.35,-0.5,0.35,-0.4] prohibited. Not part of the success test.
needs_memory_or_language: none (single fixed instruction, any stacking order accepted)
end_requirements: All target (controlled) arms must be back near their start pose when success is evaluated (it is one of the success conditions, see success list): every target arm's end-effector position within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis, not Euclidean) and orientation within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode (pose recorded right after the robot is set to its initial state). Gripper opening is NOT checked by the success test.
notes: Bowls are checked on ROOT positions only: 'stacked' means nested/stacked bowls whose root points are within 0.04 m horizontally and each higher root is at least 0.005 m higher. The bowl asset varies per episode (which of the models is used is random), so nesting height/size varies. The tilt limit for non-bottom bowls is lenient (45 deg) but the bottom bowl must be within 7 deg. No gripper-open requirement in success. A process score (15 for a pair of bowls stacked in some order with gripper open (>=0.8 normalised) and the lower bowl within 7 deg/upper within 45 deg; 100 for full stack with gripper open) exists but does not decide success. Success is evaluated on object root poses/points, not on gripper contact. Object geometry sizes/asset dimensions are not in the source and cannot be determined statically.
